title: I'm so glad Jesus set me free

lines.text: I''m so glad Jesus set me free. (3)
Satan had me bound, but Jesus set me free (3)
Once I was a sinner but Jesus set me free (3)
I''m on my way to heaven, shouting victory. (3)
